question: What attainment makes a practitioner dear to the yoginīs?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation together constitute a great accomplishment.
Such accomplishment can arise for a practitioner.
The yoginīs hold this accomplishment in regard.
inference: One who attains the great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation becomes dear to the yoginīs.
plain_english: He may become dear to the yoginīs through the great accomplishment of both enjoyment and liberation.
